output: Based on the underwriting comparable-set data, **Cedar Bluff Logistics Center** has the largest building area in the comp set, at **412,000 square feet** (sale date 2025-05-02, sale price $63,200,000, $153.40/SF, 5.65% cap rate). This exceeds all other comparables in the set, including Fenwick Distribution Hub (356,800 SF) and Thornfield Industrial Park (289,500 SF), the next largest properties.
